_note: PROVISIONAL — not schema-conformant with data/schemas/decklist.schema.json on purpose. That schema requires a scryfall_id per card, which needs bulk API access this environment does not currently have (coverage_backlog ENV-0001). This file exists so SIM-001 Phase 0 has a working, versioned artifact to build against; it gets promoted to data/decklists/tymna-thrasios-treefarm-v1.json (matching the real schema) once every card is resolved to a real Scryfall ID via either a fixed network policy or an out-of-band Scryfall bulk-data drop. Do not treat resolution_status='verified_by_search' as equivalent to a bulk-pull-verified Oracle record — it's a WebSearch-snippet spot check, useful for legality/color-identity triage, not authoritative for exact wording, full ability lists, or complete rulings.
deck_name: Tymna the Weaver / Thrasios, Triton Hero — Tree Farm x CounterSlop

source.note: Moxfield URL could not be fetched directly (EGRESS_BLOCKED, see docs/SOURCES.md) — the 98-card list below is transcribed from the card names supplied verbatim in the SIM-001 assignment text, not independently re-pulled from Moxfield. This is itself a coverage gap: we have not independently confirmed the assignment's transcription matches the live Moxfield list. See coverage_backlog SIM-0001.

cards.name: Abhorrent Oculus
cards.notes: Additional cost: exile 6 cards from graveyard. Manifest dread trigger each opponent upkeep.

cards.name: Archivist of Oghma
cards.set: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate (CLB)
cards.notes: Flash. Whenever an opponent searches their library, you gain 1 life and draw a card — relevant to interaction-burden/tutor-punish analysis.

cards.name: Badgermole Cub
cards.notes: LEGALITY FLAG (resolved, not blocking): banned in Standard as of 2026-08-10 B&R announcement (2 days before this assignment). Confirmed via search this ban is Standard-only — no Commander-format ban found. Legal for this Commander deck. Earthbend 1 on ETB; creatures you control tap for an additional G.

cards.name: Boseiju, Who Endures
cards.notes: Channel ability contributes G to color identity.

cards.name: Colossal Skyturtle
cards.notes: Two Channel abilities ({2}{G} return card from GY to hand; {1}{U} bounce target creature) — relevant to mulligan/dead-draw analysis since it's live from hand even when uncastable.

cards.name: Commandeer
cards.notes: Alt cost confirmed: exile two blue cards from hand rather than pay mana cost. Exact printed mana cost not yet confirmed via authoritative pull — flagged for full ingestion. Phase 28 explicitly requires modeling the two-card pitch requirement; this is a two-card (not one-card) resource cost, distinct from the deck's other pitch spells.

cards.name: Deathrite Shaman
cards.notes: Has received errata over its printed history — exact current Oracle wording not yet re-confirmed against a live pull, flagged for full ingestion.

cards.name: Delney, Streetwise Lookout
cards.notes: Doubles triggered abilities of power-2-or-less creatures — high interaction density with the deck's small-creature engine package, flagged as a priority interaction-discovery target.

cards.name: Derevi, Empyrial Tactician
cards.notes: Non-commander legendary creature in the 98; combat-damage untap/tap trigger is a known Gaea's Cradle / mana-engine amplifier, flagged as a priority interaction-discovery target given the deck's Cradle emphasis.

cards.name: Devoted Druid
cards.notes: Explicitly named in the assignment's interaction-discovery seed list ('Devoted Druid lines') — likely infinite-green candidate pending a partner untap/counter-removal piece; no such partner (e.g. Quasiduplicate-style or Vizier of Remedies-style) is obviously present in this exact 98, flagged for explicit dependency-graph check rather than assumed.

cards.name: Endurance
cards.notes: Explicitly named in the assignment's seed list ('Endurance recycling loops') — free-cast evoke + graveyard-shuffle-back; flagged for explicit interaction-discovery pass with the deck's other graveyard/recursion pieces.

cards.name: Enduring Vitality
cards.notes: Gives every creature you control '{T}: Add one mana of any color', and returns to the battlefield as an enchantment (not creature) when it dies. Structurally significant: converts the deck's whole creature package into a mana base. High-priority for Phase 21 engine realization and Phase 22 creature economy.

cards.name: Faerie Mastermind
cards.notes: Named in assignment seed list paired with Smothering Tithe ('Smothering Tithe / Faerie Mastermind loops') — flagged for explicit interaction-discovery check; not aware of a standard published loop between these two, treat as unverified until checked rather than assumed real.

cards.name: Flare of Denial
cards.notes: IMPORTANT CORRECTION: initially misremembered as red during triage — verified via search to be {1}{U}{U}, blue. Alt cost: sacrifice a nontoken blue creature rather than pay mana cost. This is exactly the kind of 'never guess, verify' case the charter warns about — flagging the near-miss for the record.

cards.name: Gaea's Cradle
cards.notes: Own dedicated analysis phase (Phase 23) — priority ingestion target.

cards.name: Gleaming Splendor
cards.notes: Whenever an opponent draws their second card each turn, create a Treasure; {2}{W}: two target players each draw. Confirms Universes Beyond 'The Hobbit' product is the source, per the assignment's own flagged-unfamiliar-card list.

cards.name: Hazel's Brewmaster
cards.notes: CORRECTION: initially guessed green from memory before checking; verified via search to be black (mana value 4, printed cost not yet pinned to the exact symbol string — flagged for full ingestion). Menace; on ETB/attack exiles a graveyard card and makes a Food; Foods gain all activated abilities of creature cards exiled this way — real engine/value piece, flagged for interaction-discovery priority given the deck's graveyard-adjacent cards (Endurance, Deathrite Shaman, Colossal Skyturtle channel).

cards.name: Heartwood Storyteller
cards.notes: 'Whenever a player casts a noncreature spell, each of that player's opponents may draw a card' — symmetric effect that benefits whichever player is casting fewer noncreature spells; relevant to Phase 32 robustness (spell-heavy vs. creature-heavy pods) since this deck is explicitly creature-dense.

cards.name: King T'Challa
cards.type_line: Legendary Creature — Human Noble Hero // Legendary Creature — Human Warrior Hero (transforming DFC)
cards.notes: Confirmed Commander-legal per search (Universes Beyond set legal in Commander/Legacy/Vintage). Front: draws a card whenever a player draws their 2nd card each turn — directly relevant to the deck's Tymna/draw-engine synergy cluster, flag for interaction discovery alongside Gleaming Splendor/Mystic Remora/Rhystic Study.

cards.name: Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy
cards.notes: Non-commander legendary in the 98 — own dedicated analysis in Phase 21 engine realization.

cards.name: La abundancia de Yucahú
cards.set: Secret Lair Drop (SLD) — Spanish/Portuguese-language alternate-name printing
cards.notes: IMPORTANT: this is not a distinct card — it is the Spanish-flavor-name Secret Lair printing of Sylvan Library, functionally and Oracle-identically Sylvan Library. Must be keyed to Sylvan Library's canonical scryfall_id/oracle_id once bulk ingestion runs, not treated as a unique card in the interaction registry or card cache.

cards.name: Mox Amber
cards.notes: Commander-dependence (only taps if you control a legendary creature/planeswalker) — relevant to mana-reliability analysis, since the deck's commanders being in the command zone (not battlefield) at game start matters for its early-game rate.

cards.name: Oboro Breezecaller
cards.notes: CORRECTION: initially attributed to Champions of Kamigawa from memory; verified via search to be Saviors of Kamigawa. Flying; {2}, return a land you control to hand: untap target land — a land-bounce/untap effect directly relevant to the assignment's named 'Oboro Breezecaller lines' interaction-discovery target (likely a Gaea's Cradle / land-based mana engine interaction, unverified until Phase 3 exact-line validation).

cards.name: Runic Armasaur
cards.notes: Draws a card whenever an opponent activates a non-mana ability of a creature or land — relevant to interaction-burden/engine analysis and to modeling opponents' activated-ability-heavy archetypes in Phase 32 robustness tests.

cards.name: Shang-Chi, Master of Kung Fu
cards.notes: Grants haste to activation of creatures' abilities; taps for 2 mana of one color spendable only on creature-source activated abilities. Directly relevant to Devoted Druid / mana-dork lines given the haste-for-abilities clause — flagged as a priority interaction-discovery target.

cards.name: Shifting Woodland
cards.notes: CORRECTION: initially guessed Kaldheim from memory; verified via search to be Modern Horizons 3. Enters tapped unless you control a Forest; {T}: add G; Delirium — {2}{G}{G}: becomes a copy of target permanent card in a graveyard until end of turn (requires 4+ card types among graveyard cards). Directly named in the assignment's seed list; flagged high priority for Phase 3 exact-line validation given its graveyard-reanimation-adjacent text.

cards.name: Sowing Mycospawn
cards.notes: Devoid (card itself is colorless despite {G} in cost — cost still contributes G to color identity). Kicker {1}{C}: search library for land onto battlefield; if kicked, also exile target land. Direct land-tutor-into-Cradle-access relevance for Phase 23.

cards.name: Starting Town
cards.notes: Enters tapped unless it's turns 1-3; {T}: add C; {T} pay 1 life: add one mana of any color. Confirms Universes Beyond 'Final Fantasy' set as source, per the assignment's flagged-unfamiliar-card list.

cards.name: Swift Reconfiguration
cards.notes: CORRECTION: initially guessed Simic (G/U) and Modern Horizons 3 from memory; verified via search to be mono-blue {U} and from Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty Commander. Flash; enchant creature or Vehicle; enchanted permanent becomes a Vehicle artifact with crew 5, losing all other card types (not a creature unless crewed). This is a real protection/removal-dodge tool (turns an opposing threat into an inert Vehicle, or protects your own creature by making it not-a-creature) — flagged for Phase 28 interaction-reliability classification (protection effect, not stack interaction) and Phase 3 exact-line check against any 'creature must be X' requirements elsewhere in the deck (e.g. Chord of Calling convoke, Tymna combat).

cards.name: Talon Gates of Madara
cards.notes: CORRECTION: assignment's own seed list groups this near other cards but it is NOT part of a Naruto Universes Beyond product — confirmed via search to be a plain Modern Horizons 3 Commander land (ETB phases out a target creature; taps for C or, for {1}, any color; {4}: put from hand onto battlefield). Flagging the initial mistaken assumption for the record, per charter never-guess rule.

cards.name: Voice of Victory
cards.notes: IMPORTANT CHECK: card is flavor-grouped under Mardu (W/B/R) in set marketing/community listings, which raised a real risk of a red mana-cost breaking WUBG color identity legality. Verified via search: actual mana cost is {1}{W} only — mono-white, no red. Legal. Mobilize 2 on attack; opponents can't cast spells during your turn.

cards.name: Volatile Stormdrake
cards.notes: Uses the Energy ({E}) counter mechanic on ETB (exchange control with an opponent's creature, gain 4 Energy, sac the stolen creature unless you pay Energy equal to its mana value). No other card in this exact 98 appears to produce/spend Energy — flagged as a rules-engine coverage requirement: the state tracker must support Energy as a resource type for this one card even though it's otherwise unused in the deck, per charter Level 1 fidelity ('cards must retain relevant actual characteristics').

Voice of Victory — flavor-grouped under Mardu (W/B/R) in secondary sources; verified mana cost is mono-white {1}{W}, no red.
Hazel's Brewmaster — initially guessed green from memory; verified black.
Shifting Woodland — initially guessed Kaldheim from memory; verified Modern Horizons 3 (color G unaffected).

color_identity_check.methodological_note: 5 of the ~19 cards individually spot-checked this session (Hazel's Brewmaster, Shifting Woodland, Swift Reconfiguration, plus the Flare of Denial and Voice of Victory color near-misses) turned out to differ from an initial memory-based guess in color, set, or exact cost. None of the corrections changed the color-identity legality verdict (still WUBG, no violations), but this is a concrete, in-repo demonstration of why the charter forbids asserting Oracle text from memory — roughly a quarter of spot-checked guesses were wrong in some detail before verification.
